newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM in talks to sell equipment services arm.
newsitem.headline: KLM in talks to sell equipment services arm.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Friday it had begun talks with Ryder Plc of Britain to sell part or all of its KLM Equipment Services (KES) subsidiary.
"Over the coming period KES...and Britain's Ryder Plc will conduct talks on a partial or total takeover of KLM's KES shareholding," KLM said in a statement.

It said a takeover by Ryder Plc, a subsidiary of Miami-based logistical services provider Ryder System Inc, would give KES the necessary economies of scale to continue providing a competitive product in its markets.
Like Ryder, KES leases, manages and maintains airport rolling stock.
